_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or ~/.dai-miner/config.json). This is the current recommended format used by both CLI and the Electron GUI (onboarding + RPC settings).
_model_comment: Inference runs in-process via QVAC. `model` is a QVAC model id/alias (qwen3-0.6b, qwen3-1.7b, qwen3-4b, qwen3-8b) or a GGUF URL. No Ollama.
_dhtBootstrap_comment: Optional, normally omitted. DHT entry points for the peer-to-peer transport, as "ip@hostname:port". Unset means the built-in public defaults, which is what you want unless you are running a private network. Contacted once at startup to enter the DHT; never in the data path. All nodes must agree — pointing some at an isolated DHT and others at the public one silently splits the network. See _dhtBootstrap_example for our node.
_comment_mcp: User-installed MCP servers overlay the builtin public-apis + onion-search packs. HTTP connectors accept arbitrary headers (not only Authorization: Bearer).
_comment_skills: Public skill deploy fee: 100 DAI (escrowed for code_audit). Graduation staking threshold: 1,000 DAI total.
_comment_ipfs: Local IPFS (Kubo) auto-starts to back up chain + brain state. Binary auto-downloads to ~/.dai-miner/bin on first run; repo in ~/.dai-miner/ipfs. Gateway is 8081 to avoid the bootnode's 8080. Set autoStart:false or env DAI_SKIP_IPFS=1 to disable.
_comment_genesisAlloc: Optional: pre-fund addresses at block 0 on a clean network start. Amounts in raw DAI (1 DAI = 1000000000 raw). Only applied once when chain is empty.
